LanguageData.LP_HighElfLineage.label: high elf bloodline
LanguageData.LP_HighElfLineage.description: Descendants of an ancient court, born gifted at art and learning, but disdainful of heavy physical labor. Elven subraces are mutually exclusive.
LanguageData.LP_WoodElfLineage.label: wood elf bloodline
LanguageData.LP_WoodElfLineage.description: Elves raised in the ancient forest know every woodland path, but can't sit still at a desk. Elven subraces are mutually exclusive.
LanguageData.LP_DrowSunlight.label: sunlight sensitivity
LanguageData.LP_DrowSunlight.description: Drow eyes are used to the darkness of the Underdark. Outdoors by day (daylight at least 60% with no roof overhead), both shooting and melee hit chance drop to 85%. Elven subraces are mutually exclusive.
LanguageData.LP_DrowSunlight.customEffectDescriptions: Outdoors by day (daylight ≥60% and no roof): shooting and melee hit chance ×85%.
LanguageData.LP_DrowPoison.label: spider queen venom
LanguageData.LP_DrowPoison.description: Drow blades are coated with venom brewed by Lolth's followers. Melee hits have a 15% chance to poison the target: consciousness -20%, move speed down to 80%, for 6 hours (repeat poisoning only refreshes the time). No effect on mechanoids.
LanguageData.LP_DrowPoison.customEffectDescriptions.0: Melee hit: 15% chance to give the target "spider queen venom" (consciousness -20%, move speed ×80%, 6 hours).
LanguageData.LP_DrowDarknessGene.label: darkness
LanguageData.LP_DrowDarknessGene.description: A spell drow are born knowing: call a cloud of magical darkness of radius 3 within 15 cells for 12 seconds. Hostile units inside (except drow) can't see clearly and their hit chance drops to 70%. No psylink needed, cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_DwarfArmorTraining.label: dwarven armor training
LanguageData.LP_DwarfArmorTraining.description: Mountain dwarves grow up wearing iron armor. Move speed penalties from worn apparel count only half. Dwarf subraces are mutually exclusive.
LanguageData.LP_DwarfArmorTraining.customEffectDescri: Negative move speed modifiers from apparel ×50%.
LanguageData.LP_DwarfToughness.label: dwarven toughness
LanguageData.LP_DwarfToughness.description: Hill dwarves' flesh and bones are especially sturdy: max health of each body part ×115%. Dwarf subraces are mutually exclusive.
LanguageData.LP_DwarfGrudge.label: dwarven grudge
LanguageData.LP_DwarfGrudge.description: Dwarves never forget a blood debt. When a humanlike member of this colony is killed by someone from a faction, everyone in the colony with this gene records "blood feud: faction name", mood -3 for 1 year (repeat offenses by the same faction only refresh it, no stacking); while the feud lasts, shooting and melee hit chance against that faction's members ×105%.
A companion killed by a faction: mood -3 "blood feud" for 1 year; the same faction only refreshes it.
Against members of a blood-feud faction: shooting and melee hit chance ×105%.
LanguageData.LP_HalflingBlood.label: halfling lineage
LanguageData.LP_HalflingBlood.description: Halflings are only 70% as tall as others, but their appetite is anything but small. Actual body size 70% of an ordinary person (carry capacity, caravan load and chance to be hit by ranged attacks go down accordingly), and they get hungry 35% faster. Halflings are brave by nature: they never fall into fear states like panicked fleeing, and fear-related negative moods are halved.
LanguageData.LP_HalflingBlood.customEffectDescription: Hunger rate: ×135% (the health tab shows "hearty appetite").
Brave: never panics and flees or enters other fear-type mental states; fear-type negative moods ×50%.
LanguageData.LP_HalflingLuck.label: halfling luck
LanguageData.LP_HalflingLuck.description: Halflings are always lucky. When one hit should down or kill a halfling, that hit is reduced to 10%, and "Lucky!" pops up overhead. For the next 3 days their luck is used up (visible on the health tab) and it won't trigger during the cooldown.
LanguageData.LP_HalflingLuck.customEffectDescriptions: One hit that would down or kill: injury ×10%.
Cooldown 3 days (the health tab shows "out of luck").
LanguageData.LP_HalflingHideBehind.label: hide behind the big folk
LanguageData.LP_HalflingHideBehind.description: Lightfoot halflings are good at finding cover: with an ally at least ordinary-person-sized within 2 cells, enemy ranged hit chance against them ×85%. Halfling subraces are mutually exclusive.
LanguageData.LP_HalflingHideBehind.customEffectDescri: An ally of body size ≥1 within 2 cells: chance to be hit by ranged attacks ×85% (updated every 250 ticks).
LanguageData.LP_HalflingStoutLineage.label: stout build
LanguageData.LP_HalflingStoutLineage.description: Stout halflings are a size rounder than lightfoots and walk a bit slower (move speed -0.3), but are immune to all poisons and rarely get sick. Halfling subraces are mutually exclusive.
LanguageData.LP_GnomeBlood.label: gnome cunning
LanguageData.LP_GnomeBlood.description: Gnomes are only 60% as tall as others, but their minds turn fast: actual body size 60% of an ordinary person (carry capacity, caravan load and chance to be hit by ranged attacks go down accordingly), mind resistance +60%, hard to affect with psychic blasts, charm and the like, and negative psychic moods are greatly reduced.
LanguageData.LP_RockGnomeTinker.label: tinker
LanguageData.LP_RockGnomeTinker.description: Rock gnomes are always fiddling with little parts. General labor speed ×110%, and making clockwork toys takes half the work. Gnome subraces are mutually exclusive.
LanguageData.LP_GnomeSmallBeasts.label: speak with small beasts
LanguageData.LP_GnomeSmallBeasts.description: Forest gnomes can talk with squirrels, foxes and rabbits. When taming animals of body size no more than 0.5, success ×2 (cap 100%), and these small animals don't attack back if taming fails. Gnome subraces are mutually exclusive.
LanguageData.LP_GnomeSmallBeasts.customEffectDescript: Taming animals with body size ≤0.5: success ×2 (cap 100%), no retaliation on failure.
LanguageData.LP_DeepGnomeCamouflage.label: stone camouflage
LanguageData.LP_DeepGnomeCamouflage.description: A deep gnome's grey skin is nearly identical to rock. After 2 seconds without moving or attacking, gains "stone camouflage": enemy ranged hit chance against it ×70%. Moving or striking loses the camouflage. Gnome subraces are mutually exclusive.
LanguageData.LP_DeepGnomeCamouflage.customEffectDescr: After 120 ticks still: chance to be hit by ranged attacks ×70%.
Moving or attacking: camouflage lost at once.
LanguageData.LP_HalfElfBlood.label: half-elf lineage
LanguageData.LP_HalfElfBlood.description: Mixed human and elven blood. Mind resistance +25%; aging gradually slows from age 13, and after 18 biological age advances only 60% as fast as normal. Caught between two peoples, they worry a bit more than others (mental break threshold +5%). Bridge between peoples: when a half-elf of this colony is on the map, negative racial moods between elves and dwarves are halved.
LanguageData.LP_HalfElfBlood.customEffectDescriptions: Bridge between peoples: when a half-elf of this colony is on the same map, negative racial moods between elves and dwarves ×50%.
LanguageData.LP_KoboldBlood.label: kobold lineage
LanguageData.LP_KoboldBlood.description: Small reptilian humanoids who claim descent from dragons. Actual body size 60% of an ordinary person (carry capacity, caravan load and chance to be hit by ranged attacks go down accordingly).
LanguageData.LP_KoboldPackTactics.label: pack tactics
LanguageData.LP_KoboldPackTactics.description: Kobolds always swarm. In melee, each additional friendly unit within 1 cell of the target gives +5% melee hit chance (up to +15%).
LanguageData.LP_KoboldPackTactics.customEffectDescrip: Each additional friendly unit within 1 cell of the target: melee hit chance ×(1+5%), up to ×115% (updated every 250 ticks).
LanguageData.LP_KoboldTrapsmith.label: trapmaker
LanguageData.LP_KoboldTrapsmith.description: Kobolds are born trapmakers. Trap construction speed ×200%; traps built by a kobold's own hands deal +30% damage.
LanguageData.LP_KoboldDragonServant.label: dragon's servant
LanguageData.LP_KoboldDragonServant.description: Kobolds worship dragons. When the colony has a chromatic true dragon, mood +6 "serving the dragon"; with no dragon to serve, mood -2 "masterless".
LanguageData.LP_KoboldDragonServant.customEffectDescr: Colony has a dragon: mood +6; no dragon: mood -2 (checked every 250 ticks).
LanguageData.LP_GoblinoidBlood.label: goblinoid lineage
LanguageData.LP_GoblinoidBlood.description: Goblins, hobgoblins and bugbears share one origin and all grew up in cold caves and wilds: min comfortable temperature -5°C.
LanguageData.LP_GoblinFury.label: fury of the small
LanguageData.LP_GoblinFury.description: Goblins are only 60% as tall as others and hate being looked down on: actual body size 60% of an ordinary person, +15% damage when attacking targets bigger than themselves (melee and ranged).
LanguageData.LP_GoblinNimble.label: nimble escape
LanguageData.LP_GoblinNimble.description: A goblin that takes a cut runs off fast: move speed ×130% for 2 seconds after being hit in melee (being hit again only refreshes the time).
LanguageData.LP_GoblinNimble.customEffectDescriptions: Hit in melee: move speed ×130% for 2 seconds, refreshes without stacking.
LanguageData.LP_HobgoblinNumbers.label: strength in numbers
LanguageData.LP_HobgoblinNumbers.description: Hobgoblins value formations: for each friendly humanlike within 3 cells, shooting and melee hit chance and global work speed +3% each (up to +9%).
LanguageData.LP_HobgoblinNumbers.customEffectDescript: Each friendly humanlike within 3 cells: hit chance and global work speed +3%, up to +9% (updated every 250 ticks).
LanguageData.LP_HobgoblinDiscipline.label: iron discipline
LanguageData.LP_HobgoblinDiscipline.description: Military discipline is in a hobgoblin's bones: they never have mental breaks from low mood while drafted.
LanguageData.LP_HobgoblinDiscipline.customEffectDescr: While drafted: no mood-induced mental breaks.
LanguageData.LP_BugbearSurprise.label: surprise attack
LanguageData.LP_BugbearSurprise.description: Bugbears excel at pouncing from the dark. If the target has neither attacked nor been hurt within 600 ticks (10 seconds), the bugbear's melee damage against it ×125%.
LanguageData.LP_BugbearSurprise.customEffectDescripti: Target has neither attacked nor been hurt within 10 seconds: melee damage ×125%.
LanguageData.LP_BugbearLongLimbs.label: long-limbed
LanguageData.LP_BugbearLongLimbs.description: A bugbear's arms are unusually long, reaching farther in melee: melee hit +10%.
